Precinct by precinct with Election Day, absentee (stored as mail: mail-in and absentee ballots) and provisional votes. For the state and federal contests it equals the Department's certified Allegheny figures in 31 of 31 contests, whose precinct rows are stored. Write-in lines are stored only for the county's own contests.

GetOfficeData: the Department's summary of the certified returns, each district's candidates with their statewide or district votes and the votes cast on Election Day, by mail (mail-in and absentee ballots) and on provisional ballots. The election list marks the election official ('O').
